catalysts.headline: Lightwave Logic fell on reports that foundry integration delays pushed expected volume production back to 2028

Q3 2026 results: net loss widened ~41% YoY to $7.2M; revenue ~$38,000 (+29% YoY, below a ~$60K Street estimate); R&D spend up 49% to $4.3M; operating expenses up 54% to $8.0M; company pushed expected start of high-volume commercial sales out to 2028; five customer programs (including Foxconn and Marvell) reached prototype-to-final-product stage.
catalysts.impact: Commercialization timeline pushed back further; revenue remains negligible

catalysts.headline: On the Q3 2026 earnings call, management indicated it does not expect significant high-volume production revenue until 2028 at the earliest, a further slip from prior 2027 guidance; nine-month revenue reported at $99,418.
catalysts.impact: contributed to subsequent share-price decline into mid-November
